self_time_mechanisms.name: Memory planning, schema and snapshot validation

same_pid_jit_object_verification.scope: Actual executable bytes from the same owned process sampled for CPU self time, captured only after sampling; original Object provenance exact. No timing scores or hardware retirement counts.

interpretation.scope: Optimization15 current accepted50 diagnosis only; no holdout diagnosis or performance selection.
interpretation.sample_scope: Warm checked calls plus output reset/drop. Statistical self-time, not exact frozen timer fractions, retired instructions, IPC, cache misses or measured memory traffic.

dominant_native_loop.mechanism: Ordered matrix-product reduction: shared scalar left load, contiguous two-column right SIMD load, splat, separate fmul.2d and fadd.2d, one accumulator and k-loop per output-column pair. Exact same-PID Object bytes and annotated hot window.

interpretation.byte_binding: Complete13820-byte generated function and all sampled windows byte-identical to the actual Object; diagnostic Object identical to accepted50 qualified Object.
interpretation.next_physical_work: Group two independent product output rows, reuse each right scalar/SIMD load and k-loop control, retain one ordered +0-seeded accumulator per independent row/output lane; one-column products get two independent scalar accumulators. Preserve scalar row/column tails, epilogues, buffers, source fees, source arithmetic and admission/publication.
interpretation.fusion_context: centered*centered remains a separate matrix before sum, and host preparation/ownership is substantial. That remains a separate producer-consumer opportunity; current sampling identifies a stronger direct product loop and existing MVT product-loop evidence supports sharing across matrix/vector shapes.
interpretation.prior_experiment: Native transpose induction was unselected on its single210 optimization probe and fully restored; no retry or holdout-based decision.
interpretation.limits: No speedup forecast from sample fractions/static work; one prospective probe only after full qualification, then strict optimization-only formal promotion. Goal remains below1.0x C holdout, not yet met.
